A highly detailed, cinematic prompt for an extreme close-up portrait of a young woman (intended for Sadie Sink or Millie Bobby Brown) in a snowy outdoor setting. It focuses intensely on hyper-realistic skin texture, the catchlights in the hazel-green eyes, and the presence of frost/snowflakes on the eyelashes and hair. The style uses advanced rendering techniques like Unreal Engine 5 and ray tracing for maximum realism.
Cinematic Fashion Editorial Portrait with Identity Preservation

A complex JSON prompt for generating an ultra-realistic, cinematic fashion editorial portrait. The core function is strict identity preservation, requiring the AI to maintain the exact facial features, hairstyle, and body proportions of an uploaded reference image while placing the subject in a new setting (sitting on a modern armchair) with specific studio lighting and outfit details.
